description.zh: 指定要查询的主机账户名称。最多支持128字符，仅支持精确查询。
description.en: The name of the host account that you want to query. The name can be up to 128 characters in length. This parameter supports only term queries.

description.zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID。

> 您可以调用[ListHosts](~~200665~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the host for which you want to query host accounts.

> You can call the [ListHosts](~~200665~~) operation to obtain the host ID.

description.zh:
指定要查询主机账户的主机ID数组。
> 当HostId参数有值且不为0时，将忽略本参数。仅当HostId参数取值为0时，本参数有效。
description.en:
The array of host IDs for which you want to query host accounts.

> This parameter takes effect only when the value of the HostId parameter is 0. If the HostId parameter is specified with a non-zero value, this parameter is ignored.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to obtain the instance ID.

description.zh: 指定分页查询时，当前页的页码。默认值为**1**。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。
PageSize参数最大取值为100。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。 > 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
The maximum value of the PageSize parameter is 100. The default value is 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned on each page. > We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机账户的协议名称。
取值： - SSH - RDP
description.en:
The protocol of the host account that you want to query.
Valid values: - SSH - RDP

description.zh:
指定要查询的主机所在堡垒机的地域ID。

> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-host-accounts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --host-id 1 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --host-account-name abc --protocol-name SSH --host-ids 2_,_3 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListHostAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --HostAccountName abc --ProtocolName SSH --PageSize 20 --HostIds '2_,_3' --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --PageNumber 1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostId 1
